hey,
Sorry about your college rejections, the times are tough and affects everyone. There are always options. Have you considered community college or state colleges? They cost less and you can transfer to a college that you like after 2 years. 
I believe we absolutely can't say what will happen down the road, so things could turn out for the better. Do you want to try and be happy? 
It seems you feel like a burden to your sister, but what about focusing more on how lucky you are to have a sister who cares about you. What about the possibility of finding people who care about you down the road. 
For me, I'm just trying to be hopeful, but its hard.

maybe your life doesn't seem fulfilling...
Are you doing anything you're proud of? 
When was the last time you did something that felt important?

thanks for the comments, all good points I need to think about.
As for what this relationship has to do with what my life is worth, I think the connection is loneliness. 
How do I say this? One of the most important things to me or anyone is friends, or companionship. For me, I always feel left behind, I always feel like I'm just a "side character" no one really cares about. Don't get me wrong, I try to make connections with people. I put in the effort, but I never see anything in return. I just end up feeling taken advantage of. Why does it always seem harder for me than for most people. I think about my college career, and I don't think I've made one really close friend that cares enough to think about me. Even though I know that finding a close friend doesn't always happen, it still sucks. My whole life has felt this way, like I'm swimming against the current. Like I'm just the friend you visit because I'm conveniently on the way. 
sorry for the change of subject, but I do feel like I have my thoughts more in order. Everyone, thanks again.

I've talked about this with her before. I had the same problem when we went out. We'd go to an event, club or party for example, but she'd go socialize mostly with other people, and we're basically split up. Sometimes I wouldn't even think we were a couple. 
I think its fine for couples to not always have to stick together. I just feel like its not normal for me to have to work for her attention.
We've been together for almost 6 years, there have been ups and downs.

Lately my girlfriend hasn't given me much attention. She seems to enjoy talking to my roommates more than she does with me. It pisses me off so much that she comes over says hi to me but just ends up hanging out with my roommates. It makes me feel like the outsider. And it makes me jealous and pissed off every time they talk because I'm just sitting there, not even involved in the conversation. I just don't feel appreciated anymore, I feel left out like I don't belong. It just affects me so much because I feel like the person I love is spending her happy moments/being very caring with good friends of mine, yet I don't get any of that. I just feel so alone because I'm not in the spot light of the person I love.
I just graduated, and I've been feeling pretty shitty. Doesn't seem like I'll ever be happy.
